    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    p = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))

    solution = [[0] * i for i in range(1, n + 1)]
    used = [False] * (n + 1)

    def dfs(x, y, num, size):
        if size == num:
            return True
        for dx, dy in [(0, 1), (1, 0)]:
            nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy
            if 1 <= nx <= n and 1 <= ny <= nx and not used[p[nx - 1]]:
                used[p[nx - 1]] = True
                solution[nx - 1][ny - 1] = p[nx - 1]
                if dfs(nx, ny, num, size + 1):
                    return True
                used[p[nx - 1]] = False
                solution[nx - 1][ny - 1] = 0
        return False

    for i in range(n):
        used[p[i]] = True
        solution[i][0] = p[i]
        if not dfs(i + 1, 1, p[i], 1):
            print(-1)
            return

    for row in solution:
        print(' '.join(map(str, row)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
